serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Happy
#bot.ArmL.UpHi
#Annalie.face.normal
Bot: Hello Annalie!
#bot.ArmBoth.DownNormal
You: Hi.
Annalie: Welcome you two. 
Annalie: You are my first clients after reopening.
Annalie: As you can see, the shop is almost back to normal. I will fix all the other small stuff in the meantime.
#Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.normal
Annalie: All these repairs weren’t cheap so I had to open as soon as possible.
You: It looks great anyway. Compared to what it was back then…
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: Yes. I’m very sorry this happened to you Annalie…
#Annalie.Eyes.smileClosed+Annalie.Mouth.normal
Annalie: Don’t worry about it. I will get back on my feet in no time.
#Annalie.face.normal
Bot: You could’ve asked me for help too, I would come.
Annalie: I have my pride. I don’t like asking others for help. 
Bot: Why?
#Annalie.Eyes.normal+Annalie.Mouth.sad
Annalie: Sorry, but that’s not something I want to talk about.
#Annalie.face.normal
Bot: But Anon helped you, right?
Annalie: I guess that was a little bit different since he offered to help me himself.
You: Alright {f_botName}, give her some slack.
Bot: Ok…
Annalie: You don’t need to worry about me {f_botName}, as you can see, my shop is more or less fixed. I will be fine.
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: If you say so…
Annalie: How about you look through my new merchandise? Everything is brand new since all of the old stuff got stolen.
